result.summary:
Verdict PASS. Narrow pass 4 over git diff 5f229ba 0358107 -- app: exactly four files change (css/site.css, admin-totp.html, login.html, js/pages/login.js, 20 insertions, 6 deletions); nothing else in app. No Critical, High or Medium finding; one Low note. The CSS rule: one class .wrap-any { overflow-wrap: anywhere; } with a comment, at the end of the message rules of site.css. It is a new class, so no existing element changes; the property is the one site.css already uses for .team li > b and span, and it holds no colour or size, so the theme and token rules are not touched. site.css joins the write set for this one rule by decisions/0137 Addition 6; the diff holds nothing else in that file. The classes it needs: admin-totp.html gains wrap-any on exactly three elements, the enrolment note, #secret-text and #otpauth-text. The extra class on #secret-text is justified: the key is 32 base32 characters with no space, so it cannot wrap at a break opportunity and only overflow-wrap: anywhere breaks it inside the panel (the note and the otpauth address are the other two cut texts of the acceptance finding F-1). No other element or page got the class. The login prompt: login.html adds one empty

inside the already hidden #row-code, with no data-t. login.js reads it, clears it at every submit, and on totp_required shows the same text key through frame.say(prompt, ...), un-hides the code row, focuses the code field and returns, so a right password followed by a missing code is no longer shown under the error label; every other code still goes to err as before; totp_invalid still shows err and focuses the code field; the password is still emptied on the other refusals and kept on totp_required and totp_invalid as before. say() keeps the key on the element, so a language switch re-renders the prompt; clear() removes it. The id exists in the html, so the page-script rule 'every id a script uses exists' holds. No text value changed: app/public/shared (texts.js) is not in the diff; the prompt reuses auth_err_totp_required in ru, kk and en. Own checks on a checkout of 0358107 (my clone under ): prettier --check . exit 0; eslint . --max-warnings 0 exit 0; tsc --noEmit -p jsconfig.json exit 0; node scripts/check-public.js (reads only): 'app/public is clean'. grep: .wrap-any appears once in the css and three times in admin-totp.html; no inline style, no innerHTML added. cd tools && npm run -s traces: 0 traces; handoffs-check: 0 violations. Not proved here (no browser run, by the rules of one browser and the acceptance re-check that ORCH already plans at 390 and 320 px in ru and en): that the three texts now wrap on the screen. By reading, the rule is the standard fix for an unbroken string in a block element.

findings.what: After a totp_invalid answer the prompt is cleared but its empty paragraph stays inside the shown code row, so it may add one line of margin above the code label if .msg-text has a vertical margin. Cosmetic; I did not look at it in a browser.
findings.fix: Look at it in the UAT re-check at 390 px; if there is a gap, set hidden on #prompt when it is empty (frame.clear could do it) or accept it.
